# Prétraitement

### Délimitation des zones "Sahara"

Zone_G = Zone saharienne délimitée par latitudes.

- Ajout de la colonne Zone_G qui vaut TRUE si lat_mean est entre 17.51 et 28.749

```{r}
DAYTABLE_2026 <- DAYTABLE_2026 %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = lat_mean >= 17.51 & lat_mean <= 28.749)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = lat_mean >= 17.51 & lat_mean <= 28.749)
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
DATA_HF <- DATA_HF %>%
  mutate(Zone_G = location.lat >= 17.51 & location.lat <= 28.749)
```

- Ajout de la colonne Zone_interet

Création de la zone

```{r}
#| include: false
library(sf)
ecoregions <- st_read(here( "Alice/Data_analysis_June_2026/Ecoregions2017/Ecoregions2017.shp"), wkt_filter = st_as_text( st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c( xmin = -20, xmax = 60, ymin = 0, ymax = 40 ), crs = 4326)) ) ) 
names(ecoregions) 
#unique(ecoregions$BIOME_NAME)
#unique(ecoregions$ECO_NAME)

desert <- ecoregions[ecoregions$BIOME_NAME == "Deserts & Xeric Shrublands", ] 
plot(desert["BIOME_NAME"])

sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(sahara["BIOME_NAME"])

tibesti_sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara|Tibesti-Jebel Uweinat", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(tibesti_sahara["BIOME_NAME"])
```

sf de DAYTABLE_2026 et superposition du sf tibesti_sahara

```{r}
DAYTABLE_2026 <- DAYTABLE_2026[complete.cases(DAYTABLE_2026[,c("lon_mean","lat_mean")]),]
pts_sf <- st_as_sf(DAYTABLE_2026, coords = c("lon_mean", "lat_mean"), crs = 4326)

coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
# coords[,1] = longitude, coords[,2] = latitude
lat <- coords[,2]
intersects_vec <- apply(st_intersects(pts_sf, tibesti_sahara, sparse = FALSE), 1, any)

pts_sf$Zone_interet <- ifelse(
  (lat >= 17.51 & lat <= 26.0) | (lat > 26.0 & intersects_vec),
  "Zone_interet",
  NA
)
unique(pts_sf$Zone_interet)
# Check
tab <- table(pts_sf$Zone_interet, useNA = "ifany")
# proportion
prop <- tab / sum(tab) * 100
prop # 17% de zone interet
# Add Zone_interet to data
DAYTABLE_2026$Zone_interet <- pts_sf$Zone_interet
```

### Ajout de la saison basé sur la date

```{r}
# ADD column "MIGRATION" spring / autumn in the 3 datasets DAYTABLE_2026 et TRACKS_HF_2026
DAYTABLE_2026$date <- as.Date(DAYTABLE_2026$date)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED$date <- as.Date(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED$date)
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT$date <- as.Date(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT$date)
data_sub5$date <- as.Date(data_sub5$date)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT$date <- as.Date(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT$date)
DATA_HF$date <- as.Date(DATA_HF$date)

DAYTABLE_2026 <- DAYTABLE_2026 %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

DATA_HF <- DATA_HF %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

### Variable "age" simplifiée en 1, 2-4, 5+

```{r}
#### Création variable age_group (âge qui change au 1er juillet) ####
fct_age_group <- function(df){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      age_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(age_year))),  # "adult" -> NA
      age_group = case_when(
        age_num == 1                       ~ "1",
        age_num >= 2 & age_num <= 4        ~ "2-4",   # inclut 3 ans
        age_num >= 5 | age_year == "adult" ~ "5+",
        TRUE                               ~ NA_character_
      ),
      age_group = factor(age_group, levels = c("1", "2-4", "5+"))
    ) %>%
    select(-age_num)
}
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
DAYTABLE_2026         <- fct_age_group(DAYTABLE_2026)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED  <- fct_age_group(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED)
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- fct_age_group(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT    <- fct_age_group(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT)
data_sub5             <- fct_age_group(data_sub5)
DATA_HF               <- fct_age_group(DATA_HF)

table(DATA_HF$age_year, DATA_HF$age_group, useNA = "ifany")

# Mina et Henri ont 4 ans en AUTOMNE 2026
```

Le ratio n'est pas le même, beaucoup plus de tracks de HF pour les juvéniles que pour les adultes alors qu'il y a un ratio de seulement X entre le nombre de jours d'adultes et de juvéniles. (probablement à cause de Tibordure du Chilloux qui a de la HF au sud du Mali et au Burkina Faso)

### Suncalc

```{r}

# ALT
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(timestamp_start))
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
 mutate(
    lat = first_lat,
    lon = first_lon,
    Date=date
  )
sun_times <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT,
  keep = c("sunrise"),
  tz = "UTC"
)
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- bind_cols(
  TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT,
  sunrise = sun_times$sunrise
)

# Conversion 
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_start = as.POSIXct(timestamp_start, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    timestamp_end   = as.POSIXct(timestamp_end,   format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
  )

# Calcul du temps depuis le lever du soleil
TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT %>%
  mutate(
    timestamp_moyen = timestamp_start + (timestamp_end - timestamp_start)/2,
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp_moyen, sunrise, units = "hours"))
  )


# SPEED
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(
    lat = location.lat,
    lon = location.long,
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  )
sun_input_speed <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
sun_times_speed <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = sun_input_speed,
  keep = "sunrise",
  tz = "UTC"
)
TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  left_join(sun_times_speed, by = "date")


names(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED) # sunrise.y

TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED <- TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED %>%
  mutate(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, sunrise.y, units = "hours"))
  )
head(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED$temps_depuis_sunrise)


# HEIGHT
TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(
    lat = location.lat,
    lon = location.long,
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  )

sun_input_height <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sun_times_height <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = sun_input_height,
  keep = "sunrise",
  tz = "UTC"
) %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE)

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  left_join(sun_times_height, by = "date")


names(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT) # sunrise.y

TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT %>%
  mutate(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, sunrise.y, units = "hours"))
  )
head(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT$temps_depuis_sunrise)

# data_sub5
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    lat = location.lat,
    lon = location.long,
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC"),
    date = as.Date(timestamp)
  )

sun_input_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    lat = mean(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lon = mean(lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sun_times_sub5 <- getSunlightTimes(
  data = sun_input_sub5,
  keep = "sunrise",
  tz = "UTC"
) %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE)

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  left_join(sun_times_sub5, by = "date")


names(data_sub5) # sunrise.y

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = as.numeric(difftime(timestamp, sunrise.y, units = "hours")) # Rq : Les positions GPS originelles sont lat.x et lon.x
  )
head(data_sub5$temps_depuis_sunrise)


```

### Gestion des anomalies

```{r}
# TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED

# Charline et Mina
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

summary(data_sub5_G)
table(data_sub5_G$individual.local.identifier)

jdd <- list(DAYTABLE_2026_G          = DAYTABLE_2026_G,
            TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_G   = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_G,
            TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_G  = TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_G,

            data_sub5_G              = data_sub5_G,
            DATA_HF_G                = DATA_HF_G)

# Vérifier que ID et age_group existent dans chaque jeu de données
map_lgl(jdd, ~ all(c("ID", "age_group") %in% names(.x)))

#### Nombre d'individus par classe d'âge, pour tous les jeux G ####
effectifs <- imap_dfr(jdd, function(d, nom) {
  d %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%
    group_by(age_group) %>%
    summarise(n_individus    = n_distinct(ID),
              n_observations = n(),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(jeu = nom, .before = 1)
})
effectifs

#### Tableau large : individus par classe d'âge ####
effectifs %>%
  select(jeu, age_group, n_individus) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = n_individus, values_fill = 0)

#### Total d'individus uniques par jeu de données ####
map_int(jdd, ~ n_distinct(.x$ID))

#### Quel individu 5+ manque dans certains jeux G ? ####
ids_5plus <- map(jdd, ~ .x %>%
                   filter(age_group == "5+") %>%
                   pull(ID) %>%
                   as.character() %>%
                   unique())

# Union de tous les IDs 5+ vus au moins une fois
tous_5plus <- sort(unique(unlist(ids_5plus)))

# Tableau de présence : TRUE/FALSE par individu x jeu
presence <- map_dfc(ids_5plus, ~ tous_5plus %in% .x) %>%
  mutate(ID = tous_5plus, .before = 1)
presence

# Individus qui ne sont pas présents partout
presence %>% filter(!if_all(-ID, identity))
```

# I. Echelle SAHARA

## Distances traversée zone_G

### Calcul distances de traversée par saison

```{r}
# Spring
distances_spring <- data_sub5_spring_G %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(timestamp),
    lon_next = lead(lon.x),
    lat_next = lead(lat.x),
    id_next = lead(ID),
    year_next = lead(year),
    
    dist = ifelse(
      ID == id_next & year == year_next,
      distHaversine(cbind(lon.x, lat.x), cbind(lon_next, lat_next)),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_km = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
distances_spring

# Autumn
distances_autumn <- data_sub5_autumn_G %>%
  arrange(ID, timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(timestamp),
    lon_next = lead(lon.x),
    lat_next = lead(lat.x),
    id_next = lead(ID),
    year_next = lead(year),
    
    dist = ifelse(
      ID == id_next & year == year_next,
      distHaversine(cbind(lon.x, lat.x), cbind(lon_next, lat_next)),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    dist_km = sum(dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
distances_autumn
```

### Représentation par age_group et test

```{r}
#### Regroupement ####
conflicts_prefer(lmerTest::lmer)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(nlme)

distances_all <- bind_rows(
  distances_spring %>% mutate(season = "spring"),
  distances_autumn %>% mutate(season = "autumn")
)

niveaux_age <- c("1", "2-4", "5+")

distances_all <- distances_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%                       # retire les âges hors groupes (NA)
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season    = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring")))

table(distances_all$age_group, distances_all$season)  # effectifs par cellule

#### Modèles mixtes (lmer, pour la comparaison AIC) ####
lme_dist1 <- lmer(dist_km ~ age_group + season + (1|ID), data = distances_all)
summary(lme_dist1)
lme_dist2 <- lmer(dist_km ~ age_group + season + age_group : season + (1|ID), data = distances_all)
summary(lme_dist2)

AIC(lme_dist1, lme_dist2)

#### Modèle lme (même structure que lme_dist2) pour predict niveau 0 ####
mod_dist <- nlme::lme(dist_km ~ age_group + season + age_group:season,
                      random = ~ 1 | ID, method = "REML",
                      data = distances_all, na.action = na.omit)
summary(mod_dist)

#### Prédictions niveau 0 (effets fixes seuls) ####
# Uniquement les cellules qui ont des données
newd <- expand.grid(age_group = levels(distances_all$age_group),
                    season    = levels(distances_all$season)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season    = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring"))) %>%
  semi_join(distances_all, by = c("age_group", "season"))

fit <- predict(mod_dist, newd, level = 0)

#### SE à la main : sqrt(diag(X V X')) ####
X <- model.matrix(~ age_group + season + age_group:season, data = newd)
X <- X[, names(nlme::fixef(mod_dist)), drop = FALSE]   # aligne les colonnes sur les effets fixes estimés
se <- sqrt(diag(X %*% vcov(mod_dist) %*% t(X)))

# Quantile t (plus prudent que 1,96 avec peu d'individus) ; remplace par 1.96 pour coller au cours
ddl   <- summary(mod_dist)$tTable[, "DF"]
ddl
q_ic  <- qt(0.975, df = median(ddl))   # min(ddl) = choix plus conservateur

new_data <- newd %>%
  mutate(predicted = as.numeric(fit),
         se        = se,
         conf.low  = predicted - q_ic * se,
         conf.high = predicted + q_ic * se)
new_data

#### Comparaison avec ggpredict (lmer) ####
library(ggeffects)
comp <- bind_rows(
  new_data %>% transmute(age_group, season, methode = "lme + predict(level=0)",
                         fit = predicted, low = conf.low, high = conf.high),
  as.data.frame(ggpredict(lme_dist2, terms = c("season", "age_group"))) %>%
    transmute(season    = factor(as.character(x), levels = c("autumn", "spring")),
              age_group = factor(as.character(group), levels = niveaux_age),
              methode = "ggpredict (lmer)",
              fit = predicted, low = conf.low, high = conf.high) %>%
    semi_join(newd, by = c("season", "age_group"))
) %>%
  mutate(largeur_IC = high - low)
comp %>% arrange(season, age_group, methode)

#### Représentation ####
library(ggsignif)
library(stringr)

# Couleurs : 1 an en rose, 2-4 ans en orange, 5+ en vert
cols_fill <- c("1" = "#FF6FA5", "2-4" = "#FF9F1C", "5+" = "#00B074")
cols_pts  <- c("1" = "#C2185B", "2-4" = "#C96A00", "5+" = "#00693F")
labs_age  <- c("1" = "1 yr", "2-4" = "2-4 yrs", "5+" = "≥ 5 yrs")

#### Positions x explicites (mêmes valeurs que la figure de durée) ####
offsets    <- c("1" = -0.3, "2-4" = 0, "5+" = 0.3)
pos_season <- c(autumn = 0, spring = 1.3)

new_data$x_pos      <- pos_season[as.character(new_data$season)] + offsets[as.character(new_data$age_group)]
distances_all$x_pos <- pos_season[as.character(distances_all$season)] + offsets[as.character(distances_all$age_group)]

p_dist_lme <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = new_data,
           aes(x = x_pos, y = predicted, fill = age_group),
           width = 0.28, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = distances_all,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = dist_km, color = age_group),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(data = new_data,
                aes(x = x_pos, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_season,
                     labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                     limits = c(-0.6, 1.9)) +
  labs(
    x = "Season",
    y = "Distance (km)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 26) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 28),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 28),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 23),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_dist_lme

#### Sauvegarde ####
```

## Durée de traversée de la Zone_G

### Calcul de la durée de traversée

```{r}
#### Durée de traversée par groupe d'âge ####
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

# Fonction commune printemps / automne
calc_duree_traversee <- function(df){
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(age_group)) %>%                 # retire les âges hors groupes
    mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year, age_group) %>%
    summarise(
      date_debut      = min(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
      date_fin        = max(timestamp, na.rm = TRUE),
      duree_traversee = as.numeric(difftime(date_fin, date_debut, units = "days")),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

spring_duree_traversee <- calc_duree_traversee(data_sub5_spring_G)
autumn_duree_traversee <- calc_duree_traversee(data_sub5_autumn_G)

spring_duree_traversee
autumn_duree_traversee
str(data_sub5_spring_G)

# Contrôle des effectifs par groupe d'âge
table(spring_duree_traversee$age_group)
table(autumn_duree_traversee$age_group)


#### Date de départ par groupe d'âge ####
# Une liste par saison, un élément par groupe : "1", "2-4", "5+"
date_debut_spring <- split(spring_duree_traversee$date_debut,
                           spring_duree_traversee$age_group)
date_debut_autumn <- split(autumn_duree_traversee$date_debut,
                           autumn_duree_traversee$age_group)

date_debut_spring[["1"]]     # ex. : 1 an au printemps
date_debut_spring[["2-4"]]
date_debut_spring[["5+"]]
date_debut_autumn[["1"]]
date_debut_autumn[["2-4"]]
date_debut_autumn[["5+"]]

# Résumé des dates médianes par groupe (souvent plus utile que les listes brutes)
spring_duree_traversee %>%
  group_by(age_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            debut_median = median(date_debut),
            debut_min = min(date_debut),
            debut_max = max(date_debut))
```

### Représentation et test par age_group

```{r}
#### Durée de traversée : predict sur lme (niveau 0) + barres d'erreur via vcov ####
library(nlme)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

duree_all

#### Modèle lme (même structure que lme_duree2) ####
mod_duree <- nlme::lme(duree_traversee ~ age_group + season + age_group:season,
                       random = ~ 1 | ID, method = "REML",
                       data = duree_all, na.action = na.omit)
summary(mod_duree)

#### Prédictions niveau 0 (effets fixes seuls) ####
# Uniquement les cellules qui ont des données
newd <- expand.grid(age_group = levels(duree_all$age_group),
                    season    = levels(duree_all$season)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season    = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring"))) %>%
  semi_join(duree_all, by = c("age_group", "season"))

fit <- predict(mod_duree, newd, level = 0)

#### SE à la main : sqrt(diag(X V X')) ####
X <- model.matrix(~ age_group + season + age_group:season, data = newd)
X <- X[, names(fixef(mod_duree)), drop = FALSE]   # aligne les colonnes sur les effets fixes estimés
se <- sqrt(diag(X %*% vcov(mod_duree) %*% t(X)))

# 1,96 comme dans le code du cours ; pour être plus conservatrice :
# qt(0.975, df = mod_duree$fixDF$X["age_group2-4:seasonspring"]) (ou un autre df de summary(mod_duree)$tTable)
new_data <- newd %>%
  mutate(predicted = as.numeric(fit),
         se        = se,
         conf.low  = predicted - 1.96 * se,
         conf.high = predicted + 1.96 * se)
new_data

#### Positions x explicites ####
offsets    <- c("1" = -0.3, "2-4" = 0, "5+" = 0.3)
pos_season <- c(autumn = 0, spring = 1.3)

new_data$x_pos  <- pos_season[as.character(new_data$season)] + offsets[as.character(new_data$age_group)]
duree_all$x_pos <- pos_season[as.character(duree_all$season)] + offsets[as.character(duree_all$age_group)]

# new_data ne contient déjà que les cellules avec données (semi_join plus haut)
new_data_plot <- new_data

#### Figure ####
p_duree_lme <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = new_data_plot,
           aes(x = x_pos, y = predicted, fill = age_group),
           width = 0.28, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = duree_all,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = duree_traversee, color = age_group),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(data = new_data_plot,
                aes(x = x_pos, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_season,
                     labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                     limits = c(-0.6, 1.9)) +
  expand_limits(y = 14) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Crossing duration (days)",
       fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 23) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 23) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 21),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_duree_lme

#### Sauvegarde ####
ggsave(here("Figures/Figures principales/duree_by_season_lme.png"),
       plot = p_duree_lme, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#### Taille d'effet ####
```

## Hauteur-sol (Par sub HF)

```{r}
#### Hauteur au-dessus du sol (zone G) : modèle log + predict sur lme (niveau 0) ####
conflicts_prefer(lmerTest::lmer)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(nlme)
library(performance)
library(scales)
library(here)

niveaux_age <- c("1", "2-4", "5+")
cols_fill <- c("1" = "#FF6FA5", "2-4" = "#FF9F1C", "5+" = "#00B074")
cols_pts  <- c("1" = "#C2185B", "2-4" = "#C96A00", "5+" = "#00693F")
labs_age  <- c("1" = "1 yr",    "2-4" = "2-4 yrs", "5+" = "≥ 5 yrs")

#### Préparation des données (zone G uniquement) ####
# Contrôle : la hauteur GPS peut être <= 0 (erreur GPS), ce qui est impossible à passer en log
summary(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_G$height.above.ground_GPS)
sum(TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_G$height.above.ground_GPS <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# Constante ajoutée avant le log : 0 = log simple (les valeurs <= 0 sont alors retirées)
# Si tu veux garder les valeurs <= 0, mets par ex. decalage <- 1 (log(h + 1))
decalage <- 0

height_G <- TRACKS_HF_2026_HEIGHT_G %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group), !is.na(height.above.ground_GPS),
         height.above.ground_GPS + decalage > 0) %>%
  mutate(age_group  = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season     = factor(MIGRATION, levels = c("autumn", "spring")),
         log_height = log(height.above.ground_GPS + decalage))

range(height_G$lat, na.rm = TRUE)                 # doit rester dans 17.51 - 28.749
table(height_G$age_group, height_G$season)        # effectifs par cellule
height_G %>% group_by(season, age_group) %>%
  summarise(n_ID = n_distinct(ID), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

#### Modèles mixtes lmer (pour AIC et comparaison avec ggpredict) ####
lme_height1 <- lmer(log_height ~ age_group + season + (1|ID), data = height_G)
lme_height2 <- lmer(log_height ~ age_group + season + age_group:season + (1|ID), data = height_G)
summary(lme_height2)

AIC(lme_height1, lme_height2)
r2_height <- performance::r2(lme_height2)
r2_height

#### Modèle lme (même structure que lme_height2) pour predict niveau 0 ####
mod_height <- nlme::lme(log_height ~ age_group + season + age_group:season,
                        random = ~ 1 | ID, method = "REML",
                        data = height_G, na.action = na.omit)
summary(mod_height)

#### Prédictions niveau 0 (effets fixes seuls), sur l'échelle log ####
newd <- expand.grid(age_group = levels(height_G$age_group),
                    season    = levels(height_G$season)) %>%
  mutate(age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
         season    = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring"))) %>%
  semi_join(height_G, by = c("age_group", "season"))   # cellules avec données

fit_log <- predict(mod_height, newd, level = 0)

#### SE à la main (échelle log) : sqrt(diag(X V X')) ####
X <- model.matrix(~ age_group + season + age_group:season, data = newd)
X <- X[, names(nlme::fixef(mod_height)), drop = FALSE]
se_log <- sqrt(diag(X %*% vcov(mod_height) %*% t(X)))

# Quantile t : le nombre d'individus limite les df des effets entre individus
# min(ddl) = choix prudent ; remplace par 1.96 pour coller au cours
ddl  <- summary(mod_height)$tTable[, "DF"]
ddl
q_ic <- qt(0.975, df = min(ddl))

#### Retour à l'échelle naturelle (m) pour la représentation ####
# IC calculé en log puis transformé : il est asymétrique, et c'est normal
new_data <- newd %>%
  mutate(fit_log   = as.numeric(fit_log),
         se_log    = se_log,
         predicted = exp(fit_log) - decalage,
         conf.low  = exp(fit_log - q_ic * se_log) - decalage,
         conf.high = exp(fit_log + q_ic * se_log) - decalage)
new_data

#### Comparaison avec ggpredict (lmer) ####
# ggpredict rétro-transforme automatiquement quand la réponse est log(...) dans la formule,
# ici la réponse est une colonne déjà en log : on transforme donc à la main
comp <- bind_rows(
  new_data %>% transmute(age_group, season, methode = "lme + predict(level=0)",
                         fit = predicted, low = conf.low, high = conf.high),
  as.data.frame(ggpredict(lme_height2, terms = c("season", "age_group"))) %>%
    transmute(season    = factor(as.character(x), levels = c("autumn", "spring")),
              age_group = factor(as.character(group), levels = niveaux_age),
              methode   = "ggpredict (lmer)",
              fit  = exp(predicted) - decalage,
              low  = exp(conf.low)  - decalage,
              high = exp(conf.high) - decalage) %>%
    semi_join(newd, by = c("season", "age_group"))
) %>%
  mutate(largeur_IC = high - low)
comp %>% arrange(season, age_group, methode)

#### Positions x explicites : saisons bien espacées ####
offsets    <- c("1" = -0.3, "2-4" = 0, "5+" = 0.3)
pos_season <- c(autumn = 0, spring = 1.3)

new_data$x_pos <- pos_season[as.character(new_data$season)] + offsets[as.character(new_data$age_group)]
height_G$x_pos <- pos_season[as.character(height_G$season)] + offsets[as.character(height_G$age_group)]

#### Figure (échelle naturelle, mètres) ####

p_height_lme <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = height_G,
             aes(x = x_pos, y = height.above.ground_GPS, color = age_group),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0),
             alpha = 0.10, size = 1) +
  geom_col(data = new_data,
           aes(x = x_pos, y = predicted, fill = age_group),
           width = 0.28, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(data = new_data,
                aes(x = x_pos, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_season,
                     labels = c("Autumn", "Spring"),
                     limits = c(-0.6, 1.9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
  labs(x = "Season", y = "Height above ground level (m)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 17),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_height_lme

#### Sauvegarde ####

ggsave(here("Figures/Figures principales/height_by_season_lme_log.png"),
       plot = p_height_lme, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#### Taille d'effet : pourcentage de variation ####
# Variation saisonnière pour chaque classe d'âge
var_season_height <- new_data %>%
  select(age_group, season, predicted) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = predicted) %>%
  mutate(variation_percent = (spring - autumn) / autumn * 100)
var_season_height

# Variation entre âges pour chaque saison (référence : groupe "5+")
var_age_height <- new_data %>%
  select(age_group, season, predicted) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = age_group, values_from = predicted) %>%
  mutate(
    var_1_vs_5plus   = (`1`   - `5+`) / `5+` * 100,
    var_2_3_vs_5plus = (`2-4` - `5+`) / `5+` * 100
  )
var_age_height

summary(lme_height2)

AIC(lme_height1, lme_height2)
r2_height <- performance::r2(lme_height2)
```

## Le gain d'altitude par 30 min

```{r}
library(conflicted)
conflicts_prefer(lmerTest::lmer)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(nlme)
library(performance)
library(scales)
library(here)

niveaux_age <- c("1", "2-4", "5+")
cols_fill <- c("1" = "#FF6FA5", "2-4" = "#FF9F1C", "5+" = "#00B074")
cols_pts  <- c("1" = "#C2185B", "2-4" = "#C96A00", "5+" = "#00693F")
labs_age  <- c("1" = "1 yr", "2-4" = "2-4 yrs", "5+" = "≥ 5 yrs")

#### Préparation des données (zone G uniquement) ####

alt_G <- TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_G %>%
  filter(!is.na(age_group), !is.na(alt_gain_30min)) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
    season = factor(MIGRATION, levels = c("autumn", "spring"))
  )

table(alt_G$age_group, alt_G$season)

# Nombre de valeurs et d'ID par saison x âge
alt_G %>%
  group_by(season, age_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_valeurs = n(),
    n_ID = n_distinct(ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Nombre total de valeurs et d'individus
nrow(alt_G)
n_distinct(alt_G$ID)

#### Modèles mixtes lmer (pour AIC) ####

lme_alt1 <- lmer(
  alt_gain_30min ~ age_group + season + (1|ID),
  data = alt_G
)

lme_alt2 <- lmer(
  alt_gain_30min ~ age_group + season + age_group:season + (1|ID),
  data = alt_G
)

summary(lme_alt2)

AIC(lme_alt1, lme_alt2)

r2_alt <- performance::r2(lme_alt2)
r2_alt

#### Modèle lme (même structure que lme_alt2) pour predict niveau 0 ####

mod_alt <- nlme::lme(
  alt_gain_30min ~ age_group + season + age_group:season,
  random = ~ 1 | ID,
  method = "REML",
  data = alt_G,
  na.action = na.omit
)

summary(mod_alt)

#### Prédictions niveau 0 (effets fixes seuls) ####

newd <- expand.grid(
  age_group = levels(alt_G$age_group),
  season = levels(alt_G$season)
) %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = factor(age_group, levels = niveaux_age),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("autumn", "spring"))
  ) %>%
  semi_join(alt_G, by = c("age_group", "season"))

fit_alt <- predict(mod_alt, newd, level = 0)

#### SE à la main : sqrt(diag(X V X')) ####

X <- model.matrix(
  ~ age_group + season + age_group:season,
  data = newd
)

X <- X[, names(nlme::fixef(mod_alt)), drop = FALSE]

se_alt <- sqrt(
  diag(X %*% vcov(mod_alt) %*% t(X))
)

#### Quantile t : ddl prudents ####

ddl <- summary(mod_alt)$tTable[, "DF"]
ddl

q_ic <- qt(0.975, df = min(ddl))

#### Prédictions et IC à 95 % (échelle naturelle, mètres) ####

new_data <- newd %>%
  mutate(
    fit = as.numeric(fit_alt),
    se = se_alt,
    predicted = fit,
    conf.low = fit - q_ic * se,
    conf.high = fit + q_ic * se
  )

new_data

#### Positions x explicites : saisons bien espacées ####

  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols_fill, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols_pts, labels = labs_age) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = pos_season,

  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +

  ) +
```

## Tortuosité (distance) sur le SAHARA

```{r}
#### Calcul de la tortuosité ####
library(dplyr)
library(geosphere)
library(writexl)
library(flextable)
library(here)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

#### Fonction : départ/arrivée depuis data_sub5, distance réelle depuis la daytable ####
#### Fonction : tout à partir de data_sub5 (positions à 5 min) ####
calc_tortuosite <- function(data_sub5_G, daytable, type_migration, saison){
  
  pts <- data_sub5_G %>%
    filter(!is.na(location.long), !is.na(location.lat), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
    mutate(year = lubridate::year(timestamp)) %>%
    group_by(ID, year) %>%
    arrange(timestamp, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      # Distance entre positions successives (m), NA pour la 1re position
      seg_dist = c(NA, distHaversine(cbind(location.long[-n()], location.lat[-n()]),
                                     cbind(location.long[-1],   location.lat[-1])))
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      lon_depart   = first(location.long),
      lat_depart   = first(location.lat),
      lon_arrivee  = last(location.long),
      lat_arrivee  = last(location.lat),
      date_depart  = first(timestamp),
      date_arrivee = last(timestamp),
      n_positions  = n(),
      dist_totale  = sum(seg_dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,   # km, même source que dist_min
      age_group    = first(age_group),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(dist_min = distHaversine(c(lon_depart, lat_depart),
                                    c(lon_arrivee, lat_arrivee)) / 1000) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      # Nombre de jours calendaires entre départ et arrivée (pour contrôle)
      n_jours    = as.numeric(as.Date(date_arrivee) - as.Date(date_depart)) + 1,
      tortuosite = dist_totale / dist_min,
      type       = type_migration,
      season     = saison
    )
  
  pts
}

#### -- Montée - Printemps ####
tortuosite_spring <- calc_tortuosite(data_sub5_spring_G, DAYTABLE_2026_spring_G, "Montee", "spring")

#### -- Descente - Automne ####
tortuosite_autumn <- calc_tortuosite(data_sub5_autumn_G, DAYTABLE_2026_autumn_G, "Descente", "autumn")

#### Regroupement : Printemps + Automne ####
tort_all <- bind_rows(tortuosite_spring, tortuosite_autumn)

#### Anomalies ####
#tort_all <- tort_all[!(tort_all$ID == "Barben" & tort_all$year == 2021), ]  # Anomalie

# Contrôle : trajets suspects à examiner
tort_all %>%
  filter(is.na(dist_totale) | tortuosite < 1 | dist_min < 900) %>%
  select(ID, year, type, date_depart, date_arrivee, n_jours,
         lat_depart, lat_arrivee, dist_totale, dist_min, tortuosite)

str(tort_all)

#### Export Excel ####
write_xlsx(tort_all, here("Figures/tortuosite.xlsx"))

#### Tableau ####
ft <- tort_all %>%
  mutate(across(c(lat_depart, lat_arrivee), ~ round(.x, 2)),
         across(c(dist_totale, dist_min), ~ round(.x, 0)),
         tortuosite  = round(tortuosite, 2),
         date_depart  = format(date_depart,  "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
         date_arrivee = format(date_arrivee, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")) %>%
  select(ID, year, age_group, type, date_depart, date_arrivee, n_jours,
         lat_depart, lat_arrivee, dist_totale, dist_min, tortuosite) %>%
  rename(
    "ID"                          = ID,
    "Year"                        = year,
    "Experience"                  = age_group,
    "Migration"                   = type,
    "Start date"                  = date_depart,
    "End date"                    = date_arrivee,
    "N days"                      = n_jours,
    "Start lat"                   = lat_depart,
    "End lat"                     = lat_arrivee,
    "Total distance (km)"         = dist_totale,
    "Straight-line distance (km)" = dist_min,
    "Tortuosity"                  = tortuosite
  ) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  bold(part = "header")

ft
save_as_docx(ft, path = here("Figures/tortuosity_table_correct.docx"))
```

```{r}
    var_2_4_vs_5plus = (`2-4` - `5+`) / `5+` * 100
  )

var_age_tort

summary(lme_tort2)

AIC(lme_tort1, lme_tort2)

# R² du modèle avec interaction
r2_tort <- performance::r2(lme_tort2)
r2_tort
```

=\> Aucune différence de tortuosité (distance) sur la zone sahara_z entre adultes et juvéniles au printemps comme en automne.

## Regroupement des pourcentages de variations

```{r}
#### Export des tableaux de variation d'âge (3 groupes) ####
library(officer)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)

# Mise en forme d'un tableau : colonnes 1 / 2-4 / 5+ et variations relatives au groupe 5+
make_ft <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(variable, season, `1`, `2-4`, `5+`, var_1_vs_5plus, var_2_3_vs_5plus) %>%
    mutate(across(c(`1`, `2-4`, `5+`), ~ round(.x, 2)),
           across(c(var_1_vs_5plus, var_2_3_vs_5plus), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
    rename(
      "Variable"               = variable,
      "Season"                 = season,
      "1 yr"                   = `1`,
      "2-4 yrs"                = `2-4`,
      "≥ 5 yrs"                = `5+`,
      "1 yr vs ≥ 5 yrs (%)"    = var_1_vs_5plus,
      "2-4 yrs vs ≥ 5 yrs (%)" = var_2_3_vs_5plus
    ) %>%
    flextable() %>%
    autofit() %>%
    theme_vanilla() %>%
    bold(part = "header")
}

doc <- read_docx()

#### Tableau 1 : effet de l'âge sur les variables de performance de vol ####
var_age_performance <- bind_rows(
  var_age_height %>% mutate(variable = "Height"),
  var_age_speed  %>% mutate(variable = "Speed"),
  var_age_alt    %>% mutate(variable = "Altitude gain")
)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  "Age-related variation in flight performance variables",
  style = "heading 1"
)
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, value = make_ft(var_age_performance))

#### Tableau 2 : effet de l'âge sur les variables de mouvement ####
var_age_movement <- bind_rows(
  var_age_tort     %>% mutate(variable = "Tortuosity"),
  var_age_duration %>% mutate(variable = "Duration"),
  var_age_dist     %>% mutate(variable = "Distance")
)

doc <- body_add_par(
  doc,
  "Age-related variation in movement variables",
  style = "heading 1"
)
doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, value = make_ft(var_age_movement))

#### Export ####
print(doc, target = here("Figures/variation_age_variables.docx"))
```

## Gain d'altitude : alt_gain à l'échelle de la journée (par 30min)

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false

# Montée (printemps)

# -------------------------------
# PRINTEMPS - Montée
# -------------------------------

# Modèles linéaires / polynomiaux
mod1 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ 1 + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod2 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod3 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod4 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
mod5 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + age_group + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)

# Résumé et comparaison AIC
summary(mod1); summary(mod2); summary(mod3); summary(mod4); summary(mod5)
AIC(mod1, mod2, mod3, mod4, mod5)

# Modèle choisi
mod4 <- lmer(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group + (1|ID), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z)
summary(mod4) # OK
# Axe pour les prédictions
heure_seq <- seq(
  min(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.1
)

groupes <- c("juvenile", "adult")

# Graphique vide
plot(alt_gain_30min ~ temps_depuis_sunrise, type = "n",
     data = TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z,
     xlab = "Temps depuis le lever du soleil (h)",
     ylab = "Gain d'altitude",
     main = "Gain d'altitude - Printemps",
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.3, cex.main = 1.6,
     las = 1, font.axis = 2)

# Ajouter les points réels
for (groupe in groupes) {
  points(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise[TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$age_group == groupe],
         TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$alt_gain_30min[TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$age_group == groupe],
         pch = 1,
         col = ifelse(groupe == "juvenile", "deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1"),
         cex = 0.5)
}

# Boucle prédiction + IC
for (groupe in groupes) {
  x <- data.frame(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = heure_seq,
    age_group = factor(rep(groupe, length(heure_seq)), levels = levels(TRACKS_HF_2026_ALT_spring_Z$age_group))
  )
  
  y <- predict(mod4, newdata = x, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  col_main <- ifelse(groupe == "juvenile", "deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1")
  col_ci   <- ifelse(groupe == "juvenile", "lightpink", "lightgoldenrod1")
  
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit, col = col_main, lwd = 2)
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit + 2*y$se.fit, col = col_ci, lty = 2)
  lines(x$temps_depuis_sunrise, y$fit - 2*y$se.fit, col = col_ci, lty = 2)
}

legend("topleft", legend = c("Juveniles", "Adultes"),
       col = c("deeppink1", "darkgoldenrod1"),
       pch = 1, lwd = 2,
       title = "Groupe", cex = 1)

abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50") # lever du soleil
```

```{r}
abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50") # lever du soleil


# -------------------------------
# AUTOMNE - Vitesse GPS médiane
# -------------------------------

modv5 <- lm(ground.speed ~ 1, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv6 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv7 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2), data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv8 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv8b <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group + temps_depuis_sunrise:age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
modv9 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)

summary(modv5); summary(modv6); summary(modv7); summary(modv8); summary(modv8b); summary(modv9)
AIC(modv5, modv6, modv7, modv8, modv8b, modv9)

# Modèle choisi
modv8 <- lm(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise + I(temps_depuis_sunrise^2) + age_group, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z)
summary(modv8)

# Séquence pour prédiction
temps_seq <- seq(
  min(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.1
)

groupes <- c("juvenile", "adult")

# Graphique vide
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
plot(ground.speed ~ temps_depuis_sunrise, data = TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z, type = "n",
     xlab = "Temps depuis le lever du soleil (h)",
     ylab = "Vitesse-sol GPS (km/h)",
     main = "Vitesse-sol GPS - Automne",
     xlim = c(min(temps_seq), max(temps_seq)),
     cex.lab = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.3, cex.main = 1.6,
     las = 1, font.axis = 2)

# Points réels
cols <- c("aquamarine3", "brown")
i <- 1
for (groupe in groupes) {
  points(TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$temps_depuis_sunrise[TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$age_group == groupe],
         TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$ground.speed[TRACKS_HF_2026_SPEED_autumn_Z$age_group == groupe],
         pch = 1, col = cols[i], cex = 0.5)
  i <- i + 1
}

# Courbes de prédiction + IC
i <- 1
for (groupe in groupes) {
  x <- data.frame(
    temps_depuis_sunrise = temps_seq,
    age_group = factor(rep(groupe, length(temps_seq)), levels = groupes)
  )
  y <- predict(modv8b, newdata = x, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  lines(temps_seq, y$fit, col = cols[i], lwd = 2)
  lines(temps_seq, y$fit + 2*y$se.fit, col = cols[i], lty = 2)
  lines(temps_seq, y$fit - 2*y$se.fit, col = cols[i], lty = 2)
  i <- i + 1
}

legend("topleft", legend = groupes, col = cols, pch = 1, lwd = 2)
abline(v = 0, lty = 2, col = "grey50") # lever du soleil
```
